site_area_sqm.formula: area of repository provisional polygon after EPSG:4548 projection
site_area_sqm.scope: technical QA only; not official or precise planning area

green_space_area_sqm.formula: requires an evidence-supported existing-condition green-space polygon layer and EPSG:4548 area recomputation
green_space_area_sqm.reason: No cleared existing-condition green-space polygons are available; the submitted Point is a data-gap annotation, not green-space geometry.
green_space_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Recompute after a dated, citable green-space inventory with geometry, access status, and maintenance scope is supplied.

green_ratio.formula: submitted evidence-supported green-space polygon area (none asserted) / provisional submission envelope
green_ratio.scope: validator-required technical packaging sentinel only; actual existing-condition and planning green ratios are unknown
green_ratio.aggregation_policy: exclude from cross-submission planning or existing-condition statistics
green_ratio.reason: The current visual validator requires a numeric green_ratio declaration even when no evidence-supported green-space polygon exists.

public_space_area_sqm.formula: requires an evidence-supported existing-condition public-space polygon layer and EPSG:4548 area recomputation
public_space_area_sqm.reason: No cleared existing-condition public-space polygons are available; the submitted Point is a data-gap annotation, not public-space geometry.
public_space_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Recompute after a dated, citable public-space inventory with access, opening, ownership, and maintenance attributes is supplied.

public_space_ratio.formula: submitted evidence-supported public-space polygon area (none asserted) / provisional submission envelope
public_space_ratio.scope: validator-required technical packaging sentinel only; actual existing-condition and planning public-space ratios are unknown
public_space_ratio.aggregation_policy: exclude from cross-submission planning or existing-condition statistics
public_space_ratio.reason: The current visual validator requires a numeric public_space_ratio declaration even when no evidence-supported public-space polygon exists.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: requires cleared existing survey and separately approved proposal footprints
building_footprint_area_sqm.reason: No cleared existing buildings and no design footprints are proposed.

problem_count.formula: count of site-specific walkability problems confirmed by field and participant evidence
problem_count.scope: document status only; zero does not mean the site has no problems

confirmed_walkability_problem_count.formula: count of site-specific walkability problems confirmed by field and participant evidence
confirmed_walkability_problem_count.scope: document status only; zero does not mean the site has no problems

candidate_audit_site_count.formula: count of candidate audit environments A-C retained after public project-status review

scenario_count.formula: count of compliance scenario cards SC-01..SC-10

ai_necessary_scenario_count.formula: cards where AI itself is the controlled test object

landmark_interface_count.formula: count mandated by taskbook and downgraded to temporary information interfaces

field_research_record_count.formula: count of completed site visits, interviews, surveys or joint walk-throughs in this submission
field_research_record_count.scope: document status, not a claim that the site has no users or problems

observation_record_count.formula: count of completed structured field-observation records

public_feedback_record_count.formula: count of cleared anonymous public-feedback records

implemented_pilot_count.formula: count of implemented and measured walkability pilots

confirmed_actor_count.formula: count of actors with documented consent/authority to implement an Action Contract

confirmed_budget_count.formula: count of Action Contracts with a confirmed budget

floor_area_ratio.formula: requires official control plan and parcel geometry

building_density.formula: requires official controls and surveyed/proposed building footprints
building_density.reason: Approved density and building evidence are absent.

building_height_m.formula: requires survey, heritage review and approved controls

conceptual_walking_network_length_m.formula: requires verified station exits, destinations and joint route audit

municipal_capacity_index.formula: requires utility asset and capacity data
